verdict.rationale: Runway Dev exposes a broad API surface over HTTP: generative video, image and audio models, Aleph 2.0 editing, Characters, multi-step Recipes, Model Routers, draft/upscale flows and pro export formats. It ships a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec (confirmed by probe) and an MCP connection for agents. However, nothing claims parity with the UI, and several UI-side capabilities have no documented API equivalent. Examples include Brand Kits, Runway Ads auto-publishing to Meta/Google/TikTok, the workspace video editor, and plan/billing management (credits are bought in the portal). Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of Brand Kits, Ads publishing, workspace editing and account/billing management, and independent hands-on confirmation of coverage.
